sources.title: Nanjing Road Shanghai Travel Guide (2026): Shopping, Dining & Culture
sources.content:
Nanjing Road Walkway stretches 1,528 meters from Xizang Middle Road to Zhongshan East Road/The Bund. Address: 558 East Nanjing Road, Huangpu District. Open all day. Best visit duration: About 2 hours.

Historic Architecture: Yong'an Department Store (founded 1918), Sincere Department Store (first Chinese-owned, 1917), Century Square (8,404 sq.m. with Swiss chiming clock), Shimao Plaza, West Nanjing Road luxury corridor.

Shopping: Modern Lady (traditional face creams), LEGO Flagship Store, M&M's Store, Nike 001, Apple Flagship Store, First Department Store, Shanghai New World Daimaru.

Dining: First Food Store (chocolate butterfly pastries), Sheng Da Cheng (Qing Dynasty pastry shop), Lai Lai Xiao Long (Michelin Bib Gourmand soup dumplings), Bee Cheng Hiang (premium pork jerky), Harbin Food Factory, Xianyu Taiyaki.

Transportation: Metro Lines 2 or 10 to East Nanjing Road Station. Bus Lines 14, 37, 66, 123.

Double-Decker Sightseeing Bus: 30-40 minute tours, 50 RMB. Walking Route: Start at People's Square Metro, explore historic stores, continue to The Bund.

Luggage storage available at First Department Store and metro stations (20-40 RMB).

sources.title: Nanjing Road Shanghai - China's Top Shopping Pedestrian Street
sources.content:
The 1.2-kilometer pedestrian section is the best way to experience the pulse and vibrant colors of Shanghai. Free to visit all day, shops open 9:00 AM - 10:00 PM, recommended visit time 3-4 hours.

The subway is the fastest option with People's Square Station (Lines 1/2/8, Exit 19) at the west, and East Nanjing Road Station (Lines 2/10, Exits 3/4) at the center.

Best times: weekday mornings (10am-12pm) or after 8pm for the lights. The street attracts over a million visitors daily. Visit on weekdays or during off-peak times for a more relaxed experience.

Over 600+ businesses, from luxury boutiques like Tiffany, Mont Blanc, and Omega to century-old specialty stores selling silk, jade, and embroidery. Visit during off-peak hours like lunchtime (12-1pm). Be wary of persistent touts offering fake goods.

sources.title: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street Shanghai Travel Tips and FAQs
sources.content:
Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street is Shanghai's premier shopping street. The pedestrian section spans from People's Square in the west to the Bund in the east. The 2020 eastern extension connected the street directly to the Bund.

The street is a dazzling spectacle of lights, shopping, and vibrant energy, especially captivating at night. It features a mix of international brands, traditional Chinese stores, and local food stalls.

Visit during off-peak hours for better mobility. Be prepared for crowds during peak hours and holidays.

sources.title: 南京路步行街_百度百科
sources.content:
南京路步行街位于上海市黄浦区，西起西藏中路，东至中山东一路外滩，全长1528米，总用地约3万平方米，建成于1999年9月20日。

历史：1848年辟筑，初名花园弄。1865年正式命名为南京路。1908年开通有轨电车。1917-1933年先施大楼、永安百货等大型商厦相继建成。1999年改造为全天候步行街。

设计：采用不对称的布置形式，以4.2米宽的金带为主线，集中布置城市公共设施。设有34个造型各异的花坛和三组铸铜雕塑。

重要景点：永安百货（1918年开业）、先施大楼（1917年竣工，上海首个民族百货）、世纪广场、世茂广场。

交通：地铁2、10号线南京东路站，地铁1、2、8号线人民广场站。设有观光车，单程5元。

享有中华商业第一街美誉。2020年东拓段开街，与外滩实现无缝连接。

sources.title: Nanjing Road Shanghai in 2026 – A Guide to China's #1 Shopping Street
sources.content:
Nanjing Road boasts over 600+ businesses, from luxury boutiques to century-old specialty stores. The street spans from People's Square in the west to the Bund in the east.

The best time to visit is weekday mornings or after 8pm for the lights. The street attracts over a million visitors daily, so be prepared for crowds. Visit on weekdays for a more relaxed experience.

sources.title: Nanjing Road Shanghai - China's Top Shopping Pedestrian Street
sources.content:
Nanjing Road represents Shanghai's premier commercial district, spanning 5.5 kilometers with approximately 600 businesses. The street divides into East and West sections at Xizang Road.

Historical Background: The street traces its origins to Park Lane before receiving its current name in 1865. Major development occurred during the 1920s-30s when trams and landmarks like the Peace Hotel transformed the area. Pedestrianization began 1995, completing 1999.

The Four Great Department Stores (Sincere, XinXin, DaXin, Yong'an) pioneered retail innovations including escalators and air-conditioning for Asia.

The vintage-style tram slowly glides past grand heritage buildings and modern storefronts for 5 RMB, operating 8:30am-10pm daily.

Evening: Neon signage, street musicians, open-air venues, and art installations create vibrant nightlife. Duration: 1-4 hours. Access: Metro Line 2. Shops: 10am-10pm.

sources.title: Nanjing Road (Nanjing Lu) Shanghai: Facts, Attractions, Maps
sources.content:
Nanjing Road is Shanghai's most famous shopping street and one of the world's busiest commercial thoroughfares. The pedestrian section stretches 1.2 kilometers from People's Square to the Bund.

The street features a mix of international luxury brands and traditional Chinese stores. Notable landmarks include the historic Peace Hotel and the modern Shimao International Plaza.

Best visited in the evening when the neon lights create a spectacular atmosphere. The tourist train runs along the pedestrian section for those who prefer not to walk the entire length.

sources.title: 南京路步行街游玩攻略 - 上海本地宝
sources.content:
南京路步行街全长1528米，是上海最繁华的商业街之一，被誉为中华商业第一街。

西起西藏中路，东至中山东一路外滩。2020年东拓段开街后，步行街与外滩实现无缝连接。

沿途有永安百货、先施百货等百年老店，也有世茂广场等现代商业综合体。设有观光小火车，单程票价5元。

交通：地铁2号线、10号线南京东路站。推荐游玩时间：2-3小时。夜晚灯光璀璨，是体验上海都市繁华的最佳去处。
